tool_contract: existing Phase 1B ReadOnlyQueryRecorder semantics: static aggregate SELECT only; exact legacy_uhms/uuhms guard; REPEATABLE READ; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; rollback; no row values

canonicalization.query_hash: SHA-256 of normalized_sql UTF-8 bytes exactly as stored
canonicalization.result_hash: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON result_contract with stored key order and JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES
canonicalization.bundle: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON array [tool_version,approved_connection,approved_database,structural_fingerprint,evaluation_coordinate,ordered query id/query hash/result hash triples]

privacy.placeholder_bindings: protected allowlist version only; no literals

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(i.INS_ID IS NULL) AS source_key_null, SUM(i.INS_ID <= 0) AS source_key_nonpositive, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT i.INS_ID) AS source_key_duplicate_rows, SUM(i.PAT_ID IS NULL) AS patient_ref_null, SUM(i.PAT_ID = 0) AS patient_ref_zero, SUM(i.PAT_ID <> 0 AND p.PAT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS patient_ref_matched, SUM(i.PAT_ID <> 0 AND p.PAT_ID IS NULL) AS patient_ref_orphan, SUM(TRIM(i.InsType) = 'NHIS') AS type_nhis, SUM(TRIM(i.InsType) = 'PRIVATE INSURANCE') AS type_private, SUM(TRIM(i.Company) = '') AS company_blank, SUM(TRIM(i.Scheme) = '') AS scheme_blank, SUM(TRIM(i.Plan) = '') AS plan_blank, SUM(TRIM(i.MemberNo) = '') AS member_blank, SUM(CAST(i.IssueDate AS CHAR) = '0000-00-00') AS issue_zero, SUM(CAST(i.ExpiryDate AS CHAR) = '0000-00-00') AS expiry_zero FROM uuhms.insurance i LEFT JOIN uuhms.patients p ON i.PAT_ID = p.PAT_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(company_blank) AS company_blank, SUM(NOT company_blank AND candidate_count = 0) AS no_source_candidate, SUM(NOT company_blank AND candidate_count = 1) AS one_source_candidate, SUM(NOT company_blank AND candidate_count > 1) AS ambiguous_source_candidates FROM (SELECT TRIM(i.Company) = '' AS company_blank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uuhms.sett_private s WHERE UPPER(TRIM(i.Company)) = UPPER(TRIM(s.PrivateName)) OR UPPER(TRIM(i.Company)) = UPPER(TRIM(s.PrivateShort))) AS candidate_count FROM uuhms.insurance i) candidates

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) duplicate_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) duplicate_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PAT_ID)>1) q) cross_patient_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PAT_ID)>1) q) cross_patient_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(TRIM(Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin)>1) q) cross_provider_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(TRIM(Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin)>1) q) cross_provider_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY PAT_ID,CONVERT(TRIM(Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin,CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) same_patient_provider_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY PAT_ID,CONVERT(TRIM(Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin,CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) same_patient_provider_rows

WITH member_stats AS (SELECT CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin member_key,COUNT(DISTINCT PAT_ID) patient_count FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY member_key),patient_member_stats AS (SELECT PAT_ID,CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin member_key,COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(TRIM(Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin) provider_count FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY PAT_ID,member_key),patient_provider_member_stats AS (SELECT PAT_ID,CONVERT(TRIM(Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin provider_key,CONVERT(TRIM(MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin member_key,COUNT(*) group_rows FROM uuhms.insurance WHERE TRIM(MemberNo)<>'' GROUP BY PAT_ID,provider_key,member_key) SELECT outcome,COUNT(*) row_count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(i.MemberNo)='' THEN 'blank' WHEN i.MemberNo REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]' THEN 'invalid_control' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(i.MemberNo)) IN (?,?,?,?,?) THEN 'placeholder' WHEN ms.patient_count>1 THEN 'duplicate_cross_patient' WHEN pms.provider_count>1 THEN 'duplicate_cross_provider_same_patient' WHEN ppms.group_rows>1 THEN 'duplicate_same_patient_provider' ELSE 'valid_single_scope' END outcome FROM uuhms.insurance i LEFT JOIN member_stats ms ON ms.member_key=CONVERT(TRIM(i.MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin LEFT JOIN patient_member_stats pms ON pms.PAT_ID=i.PAT_ID AND pms.member_key=CONVERT(TRIM(i.MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin LEFT JOIN patient_provider_member_stats ppms ON ppms.PAT_ID=i.PAT_ID AND ppms.provider_key=CONVERT(TRIM(i.Company) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin AND ppms.member_key=CONVERT(TRIM(i.MemberNo) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin) classified GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY outcome
queries.bindings_contract: protected-member-placeholder-allowlist-v1; five values; literals excluded from repository

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,UPPER(TRIM(InsType)),UPPER(TRIM(Company)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) patient_type_company_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,UPPER(TRIM(InsType)),UPPER(TRIM(Company)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) patient_type_company_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,UPPER(TRIM(InsType)),UPPER(TRIM(Company)),UPPER(TRIM(Scheme)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) tuple_scheme_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,UPPER(TRIM(InsType)),UPPER(TRIM(Company)),UPPER(TRIM(Scheme)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) tuple_scheme_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,BINARY InsType,BINARY Scheme,BINARY MemberNo,BINARY Company,IssueDate,ExpiryDate,BINARY Plan HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) exact_complete_groups,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n),0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,BINARY InsType,BINARY Scheme,BINARY MemberNo,BINARY Company,IssueDate,ExpiryDate,BINARY Plan HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q) exact_complete_rows

SELECT COUNT(*) conflicting_groups, COALESCE(SUM(group_rows),0) conflicting_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) group_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT SHA2(CONCAT(LENGTH(MemberNo),':',MemberNo,'|',LENGTH(Plan),':',Plan,'|',CAST(IssueDate AS CHAR),'|',CAST(ExpiryDate AS CHAR)),256)) variants FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID,UPPER(TRIM(InsType)),UPPER(TRIM(Company)),UPPER(TRIM(Scheme)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1 AND variants>1) q

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(IssueDate='0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate='0000-00-00') both_unknown, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate='0000-00-00') issue_known_expiry_unknown, SUM(IssueDate='0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate<>'0000-00-00') issue_unknown_expiry_known, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate<IssueDate) reversed, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate=IssueDate) equal_known, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate>IssueDate AND IssueDate>'2026-07-21') future_issue, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate>IssueDate AND IssueDate<='2026-07-21' AND ExpiryDate>'2026-07-21') future_expiry_nonfuture_issue, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate>IssueDate AND IssueDate<='2026-07-21' AND ExpiryDate<='2026-07-21') valid_ordered_nonfuture FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(IssueDate='0000-00-00' OR ExpiryDate='0000-00-00') date_unknown, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate<IssueDate) chronology_invalid, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate>=IssueDate AND IssueDate>'2026-07-21') future_looking, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate>=IssueDate AND IssueDate<='2026-07-21' AND ExpiryDate<'2026-07-21') expired_looking, SUM(IssueDate<>'0000-00-00' AND ExpiryDate>=IssueDate AND IssueDate<='2026-07-21' AND ExpiryDate>='2026-07-21') active_looking FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(company_nonblank=1 AND insurance_count=0) company_without_insurance, SUM(company_nonblank=1 AND insurance_count>0 AND agree_count=0) conflicts, SUM(company_nonblank=1 AND agree_count>0) corroborates, SUM(company_nonblank=0 AND insurance_count>0) insurance_with_blank_company, SUM(company_nonblank=0 AND insurance_count=0) blank_without_insurance FROM (SELECT p.PAT_ID,TRIM(p.Company)<>'' company_nonblank,COALESCE(s.insurance_count,0) insurance_count,CASE WHEN a.PAT_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END agree_count FROM uuhms.patients p LEFT JOIN (SELECT PAT_ID,COUNT(*) insurance_count FROM uuhms.insurance GROUP BY PAT_ID) s ON s.PAT_ID=p.PAT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PAT_ID,UPPER(TRIM(Company)) company_norm FROM uuhms.insurance) a ON a.PAT_ID=p.PAT_ID AND a.company_norm=UPPER(TRIM(p.Company))) x

SELECT COUNT(*) total_nonblank,SUM(name_count=0 AND short_count=0) no_candidate,SUM(name_count>0 AND short_count=0) name_only,SUM(name_count=0 AND short_count>0) short_only,SUM(name_count>0 AND short_count>0) both_fields,SUM(union_count=1) one_union_candidate,SUM(union_count>1) ambiguous_union FROM (SELECT i.INS_ID,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.PINS_ID) FROM uuhms.sett_private s WHERE UPPER(TRIM(i.Company))=UPPER(TRIM(s.PrivateName))) name_count,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.PINS_ID) FROM uuhms.sett_private s WHERE UPPER(TRIM(i.Company))=UPPER(TRIM(s.PrivateShort))) short_count,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.PINS_ID) FROM uuhms.sett_private s WHERE UPPER(TRIM(i.Company))=UPPER(TRIM(s.PrivateName)) OR UPPER(TRIM(i.Company))=UPPER(TRIM(s.PrivateShort))) union_count FROM uuhms.insurance i WHERE TRIM(i.Company)<>'') q

SELECT COUNT(*) total,SUM(TRIM(Scheme)='' AND TRIM(Plan)='') both_blank,SUM(TRIM(Scheme)<>'' AND TRIM(Plan)='') scheme_only,SUM(TRIM(Scheme)='' AND TRIM(Plan)<>'') plan_only,SUM(TRIM(Scheme)<>'' AND TRIM(Plan)<>'' AND BINARY TRIM(Scheme)=BINARY TRIM(Plan)) equal_nonblank,SUM(TRIM(Scheme)<>'' AND TRIM(Plan)<>'' AND BINARY TRIM(Scheme)<>BINARY TRIM(Plan)) different_nonblank,SUM(TRIM(Scheme)='-') scheme_hyphen,SUM(TRIM(Plan)='-') plan_hyphen FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT SUM(InsType REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]') type_control,SUM(Company REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]') company_control,SUM(Scheme REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]') scheme_control,SUM(MemberNo REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]') member_control,SUM(Plan REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]') plan_control,SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(MemberNo)>=15) member_at_limit,SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(Company)>=25) company_at_limit,SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(Scheme)>=200) scheme_at_limit,SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(Plan)>=255) plan_at_limit FROM uuhms.insurance

SELECT COUNT(*) source_rows,SUM(TRIM(PrivateName)='') blank_name,SUM(TRIM(PrivateShort)='') blank_short,SUM(TRIM(PrivateType)='') blank_type,SUM(UPPER(TRIM(PrivateType))='CORPORATE') type_corporate,SUM(UPPER(TRIM(PrivateType))='PRIVATE INSURANCE') type_private,SUM(UPPER(TRIM(PrivateType)) NOT IN ('CORPORATE','PRIVATE INSURANCE')) type_unknown FROM uuhms.sett_private
SELECT COUNT(*) duplicate_groups,COALESCE(SUM(n),0) duplicate_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM uuhms.sett_private GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(PrivateName)),UPPER(TRIM(PrivateType)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) q

SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(BillStatus)='' THEN '__BLANK__' WHEN TRIM(BillStatus) IN ('CASH AND CARRY','NHIS','PRIVATE INSURANCE','PRIVATE INSURANCE +','PRIVATE INSURANCE + NHIS') THEN TRIM(BillStatus) ELSE '__UNKNOWN__' END category,COUNT(*) patient_count FROM uuhms.patients GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
